next.reason: 1985: for a numeric-edited item 'all literals in the VALUE clause must be nonnumeric literals', and 'Initialization is not affected by any BLANK WHEN ZERO or JUSTIFIED clause'. §2023:13.18.63.3 SR6: for numeric-edited, literals 'may be numeric' and are converted to edited form by the MOVE rules (editing applied, §2023:13.18.63.3 SR11), and then BLANK WHEN ZERO 'does affect initialization' of a zero value (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR8 NOTE 1; §2023:13.18.63.3 SR8). Looser: a numeric literal that 1985 refuses is accepted, with a BWZ effect 1985 never had. Kept: numeric literals for numeric (SR2), alphanumeric literals for alphabetic/alphanumeric/alphanumeric-edited (SR4), numeric-edited alphanumeric literal (SR7), alignment without JUSTIFIED or editing (§2023:13.18.63.4 GR7), and BWZ inert for an alphanumeric literal.
